source_window.selection_rule: Independent reconstructed follow-on review of eleven zero-exposure first-party sources co-located with the five named priority sources in the cached 2026-08-23 candidate pool. This artifact explicitly does NOT claim that these eleven are the exact members of the earlier rate-limited r4 preview; no exact length-16 preview manifest containing the five priority IDs was recoverable from recent transactions.

sources.title: Multi-agent discovery of practical quantum LDPC codes
sources.note: The system couples researcher/curator proposals and persistent lessons to a MAP-Elites archive that mutates executable qLDPC-family generators under a fixed deterministic evaluator. This is strong first-party evidence for a useful scientific-search control architecture, including hypothesis-driven allocation of expensive verification, but the paper provides no matched ablation isolating the scientific-reasoning/memory loop from program evolution, quality-diversity search, and fixed fitness feedback. It therefore supports a component pattern rather than an irreducible self-evolution scientific object.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No matched state gives the same program population, executable specification, evaluator transcript, candidate/refinement history, generator capability and budget to a strongest program-search/repair baseline while a distinct scientific-memory variable forces a different ex-ante next-search or reachability prediction.

sources.title: Motif 3: Technical Report
sources.note: Motif 3 is a foundation-model architecture and post-training result. Its on-policy distillation, specialist teachers and routed experts are training mechanisms inside a static released model; the source does not expose an autonomous persistent artifact/update loop whose state evolves during deployment. Agentic benchmark gains therefore do not define a new longitudinal self-evolution object.

sources.title: An Agentic Generative Large Language Model for Treatment Planning of Colorectal Cancer
sources.note: GatorOnco combines biomedical pretraining, model merging, post-training, agent-based RL and guideline RAG. The first-party abstract establishes a high-capability domain agent but no deployment-time persistent self-evolution transition. Time-sensitive retrieval changes external evidence, not the agent artifact itself, so this source is outside the current longitudinal self-evolution ProblemGate.

sources.title: Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation for Real-world Repository Migration
sources.note: ECAT alternates an isolated discriminator and generator, accepts a repository update only when estimated Code Entropy decreases, and distills successful entropy-reducing trajectories into a shared memory tree. The strongest ablation is the independent discriminator; the memory-tree evidence is primarily optimization efficiency: the same stopping criterion is reached in 38 iterations with memory versus 66 without, with roughly half the tokens. This is explained by verifier-guided repair/CEGIS plus trajectory reuse; no same-information residual identifies the memory tree as a new causal primitive.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No matched verifier-guided repair baseline receives the same Code-Entropy objective, full discriminator transcript, candidate history, repair surface, memory contents and budget yet makes an opposite ex-ante repair/reachability prediction.
Successful/failure-guided repository repair remains ordinary corrective optimization; no structural residual survives matched evidence, edit budget, update count and held-out evaluation.

sources.title: DH-VLM: Dual-Horizon Cooperative Latent Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
sources.note: DH-VLM uses infrastructure-provided latent guidance to refine ego-vehicle representations during a single inference episode. Its Infrastructure-Driven Latent Evolution is a forward-pass representation update, not a persistent learned artifact carried across tasks. The failure of naive direct latent injection is therefore a communication/information-fusion robustness result, not longitudinal self-evolution.

sources.title: RecoverFly: A Failure-Aware Reinforcement Learning Post-Training Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
sources.note: RecoverFly revisits unresolved navigation failures during token-level RL post-training, adds a long-tail curriculum and reference-policy regularization, and reports held-out success gains. The object is standard failure-focused corrective RL and sample reweighting/post-training; there is no persistent autonomous artifact update at deployment and no matched structural sign-flip beyond corrective adaptation.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Failure replay does not satisfy the strict matched sign-flip contract after equalizing initial policy, failure/success evidence, supervision, update budget and evaluation.

sources.title: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
sources.note: MISA-T is an admission/scheduling policy for heterogeneous RL rollout serving. Its principal effects are throughput, iteration time and cache-residency efficiency while matched pass@4 remains within roughly half a point. It changes the training execution substrate, not a scientific self-evolution state or persistent agent artifact.

sources.title: From Numbers to Judgment: Specialist LLM Agents and Reinforcement Learning for European Listed Real Estate
sources.note: Larix holds model, source evidence, task instructions, output schema and scoring fixed while comparing monolithic versus specialist-decomposed prompting; the gain is concentrated in numerical tasks and does not reliably extend to judgment tasks. Subsequent GRPO changes the model policy and improves judgments. This is useful evidence for task-dependent decomposition and post-training, but it contains no persistent autonomous evolution state and is already represented by specialist decomposition/effect-heterogeneity plus standard RL post-training.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No self-evolution-specific variable remains after matching functional specialization/redundancy, source information, coordination budget and policy capacity; task-dependent decomposition gains are sufficient.

sources.title: How Can Driving World Models Do Counterfactual Prediction?
sources.note: The paper shows that direct action-conditioned prediction omits the observed factual continuation needed to preserve episode-specific counterfactual information; a training-free transport/completion construction restores that evidence and improves matched counterfactual recovery. This is strong support for information-sufficiency auditing of world models, but the treatment explicitly changes available evidence. It therefore cannot establish a same-information hidden self-evolution state or reopen a longitudinal object.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: The compared predictors do not have identical pre-outcome information: the constructive pipeline explicitly transports factual-continuation evidence missing from direct prediction.

sources.title: ExRole: From Team Trajectories to Executable Roles in Multi-Agent Language Models
sources.note: ExRole is the strongest near-boundary source in this follow-on: it derives role embeddings from prefix-local team features, trains those embeddings against next-action/future-evidence/final-return targets, freezes the train-derived role library, and shows induced-role gains over no-role/manual/random/shuffled controls plus Role-Agent-Turn interventions. However, the future targets are training supervision, and the frozen role library is loaded for new episodes rather than inferred as an independently evolving deployment state. A same-supervision learned representation/role-MARL baseline receiving identical prefix features and policy-credit information can express the current result; no matched residual beyond that reducer is shown. Preserve only as a watch seed for a future same-information representation test.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No independently testable role invariant is shown to force a different prediction after a strongest same-supervision trajectory representation plus global clustering/role-learning baseline receives the identical prefix features, future targets, role count, capacity and policy-credit budget.
Shared versus routed capacity is already directly compared and routing is not a stable primary gain; there is no matched non-additive evolution-by-routing interaction.

sources.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
sources.note: Intern-S2-Preview is a scientific agentic foundation-model training stack spanning multimodal pretraining, SFT, multi-task/agentic RL and on-policy distillation. Its agentic benchmark gains and training-stability techniques do not expose an autonomous deployment-time artifact that repeatedly updates itself, so they are capability/training evidence rather than a new longitudinal self-evolution mechanism.
